what: Right behind the card thumbnail hides a category-colored plate of the same size and same corners — when hovering the card, only the plate tilts −6° (.3s cubic-bezier(.43,.05,.17,1)) so colored corners poke out behind the four corners of the thumbnail. It stands upright again on release. Like a featured card, it can also be tilted from its resting position (--fx-rest)

options.[data-fx-part=frame] > [data-fx-part=bac: Thumbnail cells and the color plate behind them
options.--fx-back: Panel color (via style), default var(--kf-accent) — a different color per category
options.--fx-tilt / --fx-rest: Tilt on hover · at rest, default -6deg · 0deg (the featured card rests at -5deg)
options.--fx-dur / --fx-delay: Length and delay (via style), default .3s · 0s (the main card is .4s · 1s — it tilts into place after the curtain lifts)

from.where: index.html·news.html·article.html card .id-card — original .l-card_wrap:hover .l-card_area-thumb:after rotate(-6deg) .3s cubic-bezier(.43,.05,.17,1) · featured card .p-home_pickup_main_area-thumb:after (-5deg once loading ends, .4s, delayed 1s)
